items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Presumably your first date with ECM, Ruta and Daitya. ... So, I had my group and we had a tour, and think we recorded after the tour.

ctx.x: Now, I can mention this in so far as the chronology. Presumably your first date with ECM, Ruta and Daitya.

OK, so we can bring that up now as far as the chronology because that recording was made in Los Angeles, May of 1971, according to this discography, The Lords Discography. If you want to discuss that, or we can save that and discuss your tenure with ECM, or your relationship with ECM, and then return back to your “Directions” group.
